C1200.title: Datong Netizen Detained for Unauthorized AI Digital Human Livestreaming Using Cheng Li-wen’s Likeness
C1200.summary: A reporter from the Ministry of Public Security’s Cyber Security Bureau learned that Xing, a netizen in Datong, Shanxi, illegally used an AI digital human featuring the likeness of Kuomintang Chairperson Cheng Li-wen for livestream sales, severely disrupting normal online order.
